<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="x" expr="0"/>
    <data id="y" expr="true"/>
    <data id="ready" expr="false"/>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <transition event="go" cond="x > 1 or x < 0 and y" target="b"/>
    <transition event="wait" cond="x == 1 and not ready" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

notes: a condition that cannot be parsed raises `error.execution` and evaluates as false, so this condition can never hold
